text:
Ana (People Ops): Heads up — we have a small cohort arriving Monday (3 people). Two remote, one NYC. Need to confirm I-9 workflow and laptop/badge timing. Anyone on deck for day-1?
Mike R: I can handle imaging + VPN before they start. Names/emails?
Ana (People Ops): Maria Gomez <maria.g@redwood.com> (remote), Derek Cho <derek.c@redwood.com> (remote), Priya Patel <priya.p@redwood.com> (NYC).
Ben - IT: Badge printers low on stock — recommend pickup window 9:00–10:00 AM at lobby. If they need building access after 10 we'll need escort requests filed.
Tara L: I-9 notes: Remote hires must complete the e-verify kiosk before day 1 AND drop off physical docs at People Ops within 3 business days. NYC hire we can verify in-person on day 1 at the desk. Who's meeting them?
Ana (People Ops): Assigning buddies — @Sophie K will meet Priya in lobby at 8:45 and escort to orientation. Remote hires get buddy video call at 9:15. Sophie ok?
Sophie K: Yep, I'll be there. Quick Q — one candidate's passport is expired, they do have a valid SSN. Is that ok for I-9?
Tara L: Expired passport is not acceptable as List A. They can do List B (DL) + List C (SSN card). I'll DM the candidate checklist link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/i9-acceptable-docs
HR Bot: Background check statuses — Maria Gomez: clear ✅, Derek Cho: pending (ID verification outstanding), Priya Patel: clear ✅
Ana (People Ops): Ok — Ben, please hold Priya's laptop until Derek's background clears. If Derek's pending >48h we'll allocate a loaner.
Ben - IT: Roger. Also need mac serials for DEP enrollment and KMS binding. Please DM serials. Example format:
```
serials:
- C02XXXXXXX
- C02YYYYYYY
```
Mike R: I'll stage VPN certs and MDM profile night before. Send full legal names exactly as on ID for cert generation.
Ana (People Ops): :calendar: Final checklist — react with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your item
```
- I-9 scheduled
- Background checks clear
- Laptop imaged and KMS applied
- Badge pickup window confirmed
- Buddy assigned and invites sent
```
Sophie K: :white_check_mark: buddy + invite done
